The account and license settings pane: product and tier, the holder, Manage, devices, Cloud Sync status, updates, managed settings and Sign out. A license that is not in an account says so, and offers to add a name and email.

<ComponentStates component="AccountAndLicense" />

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    **Drop-in.** `status`; the Textual app's Account page (`polaris_key.ui.terminal.textual_app.run_app(client)`, `[tui]`).

    **Styled part.** `screens.gate(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `gate_view("ok", …)` → `GateView(component="AccountAndLicense")` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    **Drop-in.** `status` (`statusFlow`) on a usable license: the tier and who holds it
    (`signed-in`, or `key-only`), how long it works offline, the version and channel. `logout`
    (`logoutFlow`) asks before it signs out; `deactivate` (`deactivateFlow`) releases the license
    on this device. Both take `--yes`.

    **Styled part.** `tableRows` for the aligned rows, and the `promptConfirm` primitive for the
    question.

    **Headless.** `statusView(input)`: AccountAndLicense with `tier`, `holder` and `graceUntil`.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
